description: This PHP class defines the EmailConfiguration entity used in OrangeHRM, representing email setting configurations stored in database with ORM annotations and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: EmailConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing email configuration settings, mapped to the 'ohrm_email_configuration' database table with ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the email configuration.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the email configuration.

methods.name: getMailType
methods.description: Returns the mail type setting, e.g., SMTP, Sendmail.

methods.name: getSentAs
methods.description: Returns the email address or sender name used to send emails.

methods.name: setSentAs
methods.description: Sets the email address or sender name used to send emails.

methods.name: getSmtpPort
methods.description: Returns the SMTP server port number.

methods.name: setSmtpPort
methods.description: Sets the SMTP server port number.

methods.name: getSmtpUsername
methods.description: Returns the username used for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setSmtpUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: getSmtpPassword
methods.description: Returns the password used for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setSmtpPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: getSmtpAuthType
methods.description: Returns the SMTP authentication type, e.g., login, none.

methods.name: getSmtpSecurityType
methods.description: Returns the SMTP security type, e.g., SSL, TLS.
